definitions.tokens: exact tokenizer on rendered memory payload, not provider usage; same renderer for A/B
definitions.full: all canonical-authorized active memories; no qrel filtering, no retrieval limit
definitions.context: production compile/consume, 2048 conservative-character budget, output10; current rules unchanged
definitions.positive_denominator: 42 new answerable queries with permitted active evidence in static raw-history corpus
definitions.negative_denominator: 6 unanswerable queries; excluded from Recall/MRR/nDCG and positive empty-context denominator
definitions.stage_loss: lost all gold candidates compared to preceding stage; conditional denominator reported separately
definitions.failures: request failure counts as retrieval quality zero and empty-context failure; token statistics exclude failures with explicit count
definitions.governance: 24 operation fixtures, eight families; duplicate/conflict label accuracy separate from full-state scenario pass
definitions.scope: correct policy denial is success, not false empty context; unauthorized/forgotten/stale probes separate from static positives
definitions.multi_turn: literal user/assistant history concat, no query rewriting; not native conversation reasoning
definitions.scope_boundary: governed Repository and evaluation projection acknowledgments, no Mem0/ES HTTP or production SLO
